title: Canadian Museum of Immigration Pier 21 Private Guided Experience
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: All sales are final. No refund is available for cancellations.
blurb:
*In order to deliver the best personalized experience, a member will be reaching out to you from the Museum team to gather information tailored to your interests. 

What's Included:
• A personalized experience — before your visit, we'll reach out to learn what brings you to our Museum, whether that's tracing a family connection or exploring a particular chapter of immigration history
• Private guided tour through both core Museum exhibitions, tailored around your interests
• Dedicated and knowledgeable Interpreter sharing rare stories of the nearly one million people who passed through Pier 21 — and the millions more who arrived at other points of entry across Canada
• Keepsake of the Pier 21: A History Book, an engaging history of Halifax’s iconic immigration gateway by Canadian Museum of Immigration historians Steven Schwinghamer and Jan Raska

PS Please book 4 weeks in advance for the custom tour. The bookings will not be accepted if made within 4 weeks of the arrival date.
